audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Jax/Jax/Jax/Jax/Skill/Jax/Jax while the why-text underneath argued the opposite at four rows: whys[0] says her Frost Armor edges level 1, whys[1] says trades stay even, whys[5] says fights are close rather than clean, whys[6] says a full-tank Sejuani wins.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Sejuani/Skill/Jax/Skill/Jax/Skill/Sejuani at 50.61% over 490 games — an even lane, not a 5-row Jax sweep. The prose already matched the packet; only the enum rows were stale.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Sejuani / Skill / Jax / Skill / Jax / Skill / Sejuani in both layers, ratings realigned to 4, 5, 7, 5, 7, 5, 3.

audit.why: Four spikes present and accurate: level 3 full pattern, level 6 ultimate (110/100/90s), Trinity Force vs her first tank item, and late full-tank Sejuani. Glacial Prison at 120/105/90s is the fight-gating cooldown at 6 and mid already says so.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every 'track Permafrost's cooldown' line was mechanically wrong. Permafrost (E) has a 1.5s cooldown — it is gated by Frost stacks, not by a timer, so there is no cooldown window to engage in.
audit.why: Permafrost only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks; the stacks come from Winter's Wrath (W, 9/8/7/6/5s) and Arctic Assault (Q, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s). Those are the real timers. Confirmed against the mirror audit: Counter Strike dodges her basic attacks, while Winter's Wrath and Permafrost pass straight through it — so E must answer her autos and the recast stun must land before she detonates.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t now name the 1.5s Permafrost, the Frost-stack gate, and the Winter's Wrath / Arctic Assault cooldowns that actually gate her stun.
sources: brief enemyKit E cd 1.5, W cd 9/8/7/6/5, Q cd 18/16.5/15/13.5/12

audit.whatIsWrong: Same root cause as point 4 — the 'most punishable cooldown' was listed as Permafrost.
audit.why: Arctic Assault at 18s rank 1 is the punishable one; a whiffed or spent Q leaves her without a gap-closer for the length of your full pattern.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten around Winter's Wrath and Arctic Assault.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Sejuani contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Frost Armor's free Armor/MR edges your one-ability level 1, and her damage is percent-HP, not the autos Counter Strike dodges.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Sejuani's Permafrost is down.
edits.after: Counter Strike's stun is not unlocked yet and she will not dump autos into it, so the level-2 exchange stays even.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Permafrost's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You edge extended trades but cannot burst a tank, so leads come slowly — freeze near your side and take chip on empty Frost stacks.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sejuani's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your ultimate's Armor/MR recast lets you commit through a Permafrost stun and grind a tank with no burst — force it while Glacial Prison is down.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Permafrost's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force spikes you, but her first tank item blunts your on-hit ramp — duels stay close.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sejuani carry threat 5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-tank Sejuani out-armors your on-hit and Glacial Prison wins the 5v5 — splitpush the side she is too slow to rotate to.

edits.before: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Permafrost is a 1.5s stun gated by Frost stacks, not cooldown — fight before Winter's Wrath stacks you.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sejuani Permafrost: 1.5s cooldown — the gate is Frost stacks, so the real timers are Winter's Wrath (9/8/7/6/5s) and Arctic Assault (18s at rank 1). - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Sejuani's Permafrost: Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. When it is down — E-counter his KA, Q-W burst.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges her autos, not Winter's Wrath or Permafrost. Fight on empty Frost stacks — Arctic Assault is 18s at rank 1.
